lines.port: // The lower screen draws every state of the relearner itself (3ds_field_relearn_impl.h), a remote for this screen: the list (the Pokemon,
// the moves it can remember, then CANCEL, the cursor and the selected move's numbers and description) while the list takes its keys, and
// over the dimmed list the question with its YES / NO or the message FireRed prints in its text window (Panel, Message, MenuCursor);
// before the first frame of the list, and between the Summary and it, nothing but the backdrop. The move to forget is the Summary's own
// screen, which the lower screen draws on its own (CtrBottomLearn_*). It answers with the game's own keys (the list's UP / DOWN and A,
// a YES / NO's cursor and A, A on a message), so the game decides everything.
// The relearner runs its own callback with its state machine up (any state: the list, a question, a message, a fade).
// The states in which a question is up or being put up: its text is printed, its YES / NO exists from the state after (the machine
// goes on only when the text printer has finished).
// What the lower screen shows (PT_RL_PANEL_*, 3ds_poketouch.h): 0 the list, 1 a message over it, 2 a question with YES / NO over it,
// 3 nothing but the backdrop (the screen is being set up or is not there).
return gSpecialVar_0x8004 == TRUE ? 1 : 0;      // it fades out with what it said last: it learned a move, or it gave up
if (state == MENU_STATE_PRINT_WHICH_MOVE_PROMPT || state == MENU_STATE_SHOW_MOVE_SUMMARY_SCREEN || state >= MENU_STATE_DOUBLE_FANFARE_FORGOT_MOVE
// What the screen takes now: 0 nothing (a fade, a text being printed, a state that goes on by itself), 1 the list's keys, 2 a YES / NO's
// (its B is NO), 3 A on the message that ends it.
if (state == MENU_STATE_TEACH_MOVE_CONFIRM || state == MENU_STATE_GIVE_UP_CONFIRM || state == MENU_STATE_CONFIRM_DELETE_OLD_MOVE
// The state the machine is in (a tap's plan belongs to it), -1 when the screen is not there.
// The cursor of the YES / NO (0 YES, 1 NO).
// The question or message FireRed has printed in its text window (its text as the Party's messages are read: mixed case, the lines joined).
// Two states print their text only on the next frame: the machine is in them but the window still holds the last one.
